🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 6, 2026

Moon and Jupiter hold a conjunction in Leo. The same fire temperament, twice over: what you own and what you want stop being two questions.

Easier — Naming what you actually want, before naming what it costs.
Harder — Keeping perspective on a thing you are standing inside.
Backdrop — Neptune and Pluto hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars rules you from Leo, untitled. Moon trines you from Leo, meeting no resistance. Fire begins, and beginning asks little today. Mars left Cancer four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. From Leo, Moon cuts across the appetite. Fixed earth: the grip is the expense. Four weeks ago Venus was still in Libra: the ground has moved.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Moon in Leo makes room for you, and then waits. Air that changes shape, and the shape fits. Mercury has been out of Virgo for four weeks now.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you, untitled in Leo. Mercury in Scorpio sides with you before you have argued. Cardinal water opens the account without argument. The opposition to Venus that held a week ago has let go.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you, unsupported in Libra. Moon is in your sign now, handling what you own at close range. Fixed fire: what you hold and who you are merge. Sun has not been in Virgo for four weeks.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. Venus sextiles you from Scorpio: a door left ajar. Earth adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. The hold Jupiter had two weeks ago is not there any more.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. Moon in Leo leaves a door ajar; nothing walks through it alone. Cardinal air: beginning costs almost nothing. Moon let go of it a week ago.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you and passes through Leo as a guest. From Leo, Moon sets a figure against the wanting. Water that holds on, charged for holding. Two weeks ago Mars was still held by Sun; that is finished.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. From Leo, Moon agrees with you: the easy angle, also the lazy one. Mutable fire keeps two accounts, and both balance. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you and is weak in Aries: the grip tightens too soon. Sun squares you from Libra: wanting and cost refuse to agree. Earth moves first and pays first. The sextile of two weeks ago is off it now.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Moon faces you from Leo: your measure comes back as someone else’s. Air holds on, and the holding is billed. A week ago there was nothing here to describe.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. Venus in Scorpio trines you: agreement arrives before the argument. Water bends, and bending costs nothing here. A week ago this angle was not there. It is now.
